summary: Air-date lane only. The withheld ep 31 is Lesson31「目指せ!! 憧れの沖縄行路」 (Destination: Okinawa), broadcast 2000-05-07 — the Sunday between ep 30 (04-30) and ep 32 (05-14), both of which are already correct in our data. AFL's 2014-02-07 is unsupported by anything; the series ended 2000-09-24. One repair, no true deviation.
